units.function: Focused jsdom specification for AgentDetail PromptsTab instruction-file editor selection and saving behavior.
units.dependencyDirection: The test imports PromptsTab from the 4,360-line AgentDetail page, mocks Agent instruction CRUD/assets/company/sidebar/capabilities and replaces the Markdown editor with a textarea.
units.keyDataModels: AgentInstructionsBundle, file summary/detail metadata, managed/entry/resolved paths, editable/deprecated/virtual flags and external dirty/save/cancel callbacks.
units.lifecycle: Fetch bundle/file; choose Markdown versus raw editor using server metadata, pending filename or suffix fallback; edit draft; invoke external save action; assert file-save payload.
units.testAssessment: Focused Vitest passed 4/4 cases on 2026-08-19. It covers extensionless server-declared Markdown, pending .md creation, missing-metadata suffix fallback and server metadata overriding a .md suffix. It omits bundle/entry updates, delete, legacy clearing, save conflicts/errors, auth/tenant, path/size/content security, navigation dirty state, mobile/a11y and approval/evidence.
units.designRationale: Treat authoritative file metadata as primary editor-mode signal while preserving useful suffix behavior before metadata exists or for legacy responses.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS needs governed versioned Agent instruction changes with exact content digests, provenance, permissions/data impact, accountable approval and runtime proof, while still rendering each file with the correct editor.
units.companyOsFit: ADAPT the metadata-precedence test matrix and external dirty/save contract. Add immutable instruction revisions, optimistic concurrency, safe path/content/upload validation, policy/approval and Connector materialization attestation; do not treat mutable filesystem files as the responsibility record.
units.responsibilityConflict: The tested save binds only Agent id, path, content, legacy-clear flag and company id—no author, responsible human, reason, risk, permission/data contract, approval digest or evidence receipt.
evidence: d1f6a6850a3b765f7580b172f3a06fd1f9b9e2c8 Fix agent detail URL after agent rename (#9340)
9a1d4b7983dfd50e8eb40ee9770e44999d405f60 fix(ui): use prose editor for markdown agent instructions (#9332)
securityFindings: All capabilities and company context are fixed-success mocks; authorization and tenant isolation are unproved.
Markdown editor and asset upload are mocked, so sanitization, upload validation and content-boundary behavior are unproved.
Fixtures expose absolute managed paths but test no traversal, canonicalization, allowlist or path-disclosure behavior.
Save payload has no expected revision/digest, making concurrent overwrite and approval-to-content substitution possible unless enforced elsewhere.
No error, deletion, bundle-entry, large-content or untrusted-image behavior is covered.

units.function: Pure navigation tests mapping the latest Agent Run snapshot to a Work detail route or Run detail fallback.
units.dependencyDirection: The tests import two pure helpers from AgentDetail and consume shared HeartbeatRun contextSnapshot plus a caller-built Work lookup map.
units.keyDataModels: HeartbeatRun id/contextSnapshot issueId or legacy taskId, LatestRunIssue id/identifier/title/status and derived runHref/rowHref/task.
units.lifecycle: Prefer issueId over taskId; resolve from bounded/fallback lookup; navigate to identifier/id Work route when found, otherwise to Run detail.
units.testAssessment: Focused Vitest passed 12/12 cases in this file on 2026-08-19. It covers modern/legacy ids, precedence, missing identifiers, timer Runs, bounded-list misses, targeted-fetch fold-in and non-string coercion. It omits authorization, stale/deleted/reassigned Work, snapshot authenticity, responsibility/evidence context, URL encoding and component accessibility.
units.designRationale: Make a live Run row lead to the Work the operator cares about while preserving a Run-detail fallback and backward compatibility with older snapshots.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS Agent Boss views need stable links from execution to Work, responsibility contract and evidence even when projections are paginated or historical schemas differ.
units.companyOsFit: ADAPT the explicit fallback chain and targeted lookup, but resolve opaque typed Work references through a tenant-authorized projection API and show responsibility/evidence context rather than trusting arbitrary snapshot fields.
units.responsibilityConflict: Navigation identifies Work only; it does not prove who requested or owns it, which Agent/runtime executed, what was approved or which evidence/result belongs to the Run.
evidence: b67c512f8228f0bd5ddcc4cfd92676ba1ab31cf7 feat(ui): live run label → run detail, running row → task detail (#11034)
securityFindings: Fallback targeted fetching must enforce tenant/resource authorization; the pure lookup test cannot prove it.
Snapshot ids are accepted and even coerced from non-string values without authenticity/schema validation in the helper.
Generated routes are not tested with reserved or malformed identifiers.
No stale/deleted/cross-company Work behavior or responsibility/evidence projection is tested.

units.function: Pure tests for converting heartbeat progress into synthetic system log lines, replay dedup keys and repairing an Agent route/cache after rename.
units.dependencyDirection: The tests import pure helpers from AgentDetail and use React Query cache plus a mocked navigation function; no live event transport or rendered component is exercised.
units.keyDataModels: Free-text progress message/phase/updatedAt, log ts/stream/chunk, replay composite key and Agent id/urlKey route references.
units.lifecycle: Trim progress; prefix optional phase; choose event/fallback timestamp; concatenate log fields for replay dedup; after rename clear stale route cache and replace navigation when urlKey changes.
units.testAssessment: Focused Vitest passed 6/6 cases in this file on 2026-08-19. It covers phase/no-phase formatting, empty suppression, composite key and changed/unchanged rename routes. It omits ordering/skew, untrusted or oversized text, duplicate legitimate events, stable phase codes/event ids, evidence linkage, cross-company collisions and rendered accessibility.
units.designRationale: Surface lightweight heartbeat progress inside existing Run logs and keep Agent deep links canonical after human-visible renames.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS needs structured, replay-safe Connector progress and stable opaque identity routes while retaining human-readable labels separately.
units.companyOsFit: REFERENCE the presentation intent; require Connector event ids, sequence/fencing, stable progress codes, structured parameters and evidence references. Keep routes based on opaque IDs or server-issued slugs with tenant scope, not mutable names alone.
units.responsibilityConflict: Synthetic progress text is observability, not evidence; it is not bound to a responsibility contract, approved action, runtime attestation or immutable event identity.
evidence: 85e36aaefb37cc258e295d8667156bfa96ef3723 Show heartbeat progress in run logs (#8965)
securityFindings: Progress is free text promoted to system logs, with no stable code, size/content validation or evidence semantics.
Replay dedup uses timestamp, stream and content rather than a source event id/sequence, so equal legitimate events can collapse and reworded duplicates can repeat.
Timestamp ordering, clock skew, delayed events and cross-runtime replay are untested.
Route/cache tests do not cover tenant scope, collisions, reserved urlKeys or authorization.
